_note: Every number here changes by SEBI/NSE circular or broker policy. Each block carries a 'verified' date: set it when you check the source. market_in.py warns on any block whose 'verified' is null.

cas._note: SEBI Closing Auction Session, effective 2026-08-03, Phase 1 = F&O stocks only. Continuous trading in these stocks stops at 15:15; 15:15-15:35 is the auction.

tick_bands._note: Tick size is set per stock by NSE, not purely by today's price. Always pass the stock's tick_size from Kite to market_in.tick_size(); these bands are only an approximate fallback. Observed: IDEA 11.91->0.01, ITC 301->0.05, SBIN 1132->0.05, TCS 2460->0.10, EICHERMOT 8172->0.50, MARUTI 14010->1, PAGEIND 30100->5, MRF 129605->5.
tick_bands._format: [upper_price_exclusive, tick]; last band uses null for no upper limit
